event_title: Atlanta rally: "we will overcome this together"
stated_purpose: Rally supporters and respond to the FBI search in Fulton County
observable_function: 30-minute speech; campaign press secretary said roughly 1,400 attended
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the third rally of the campaign, used to convert a national controversy into a turnout argument.
main_messages: Cost of groceries and health care; democracy; immigration enforcement
speech_summary: Attacked tax cuts, rural clinic closures and the FBI seizure of 2020 election documents; promised the "biggest and most unstoppable turnout in state history".
visual_notes: Stage speech, no teleprompter detail reported
analyst_notes: Crowd figure is campaign-supplied, not an independent count.

event_title: First U.S. Senate debate (Atlanta News First / Gray Media)
stated_purpose: Televised general-election debate
observable_function: Hour-long debate moderated by Rick Folbaum, questions from Gray Media journalists
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the only televised head-to-head; Ossoff used it to prosecute Collins’s record rather than defend his own.
main_messages: Tariffs; health-care costs; Iran war; Collins’s associates
speech_summary: Ossoff called Collins’s ties to white nationalists a dishonour and blamed tariffs for grocery prices; Collins called him a "trust fund kid".
visual_notes: Two podiums, studio set, broadcast graphics
analyst_notes: Video link is the one listed in the Wikipedia debate table; not independently played back.

event_title: Second debate (Atlanta Press Club Loudermilk-Young series)
stated_purpose: Second and final debate before election day
observable_function: Televised debate staged at GPB; pool photography
analyst_interpretation: INTERPRETATION: the second debate widened the argument to immigration and Epstein, and closed the debate cycle.
main_messages: Immigration; Iran war; Epstein; ethics investigation
speech_summary: Collins framed it as "Georgia vs Georgetown"; Ossoff pressed him on the ethics inquiry and on Klan ties in his organisation.
analyst_notes: Wikipedia’s debate table lists only the October 8 debate.
